scalar_areal.label: $t$ and $\theta$
scalar_areal.input: $P=\tfrac12J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $\Phi=\tfrac7{20}J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $\lambda=\tfrac{99}{200}B$, with $B=\tfrac12t^2(J_0^2+J_1^2)-tJ_0J_1\cos^2\theta$ and $J_0,J_1$ the Bessel functions of the first kind at $t$.
caption: The plane of $t$ and $\theta$ ($x=y=0$), with identified spatial edges and null geodesics $t\pm\theta$ constant.

scalar_logarithmic.label: $\tau$ and $\theta$
scalar_logarithmic.input: $P=\tfrac12J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $\Phi=\tfrac7{20}J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $\lambda=\tfrac{99}{200}B$, with $B=\tfrac12t^2(J_0^2+J_1^2)-tJ_0J_1\cos^2\theta$ and $J_0,J_1$ the Bessel functions of the first kind at $t$.
caption: The plane of $\tau$ and $\theta$ ($x=y=0$), with future upwards along $-\tau$. The two spatial edges are identified.

electromagnetic_areal.label: $t$ and $\theta$
electromagnetic_areal.input: $U=\tfrac12\ln t+\tfrac25J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $P=2\ln\cosh U+\ln t$, $\chi=\tanh U$, $\lambda=4(\bar\lambda+\ln\cosh U)+\ln t$, with $\bar\lambda=\tfrac14\ln t+\tfrac25J_0(t)\cos\theta+\tfrac4{25}B$ and $B=\tfrac12t^2(J_0^2+J_1^2)-tJ_0J_1\cos^2\theta$; $J_0,J_1$ are Bessel functions of the first kind at $t$.
caption: The plane of $t$ and $\theta$ ($x=y=0$), with identified spatial edges and null geodesics $t\pm\theta$ constant.
